title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
Join our AI team to build intelligent solutions that transform how businesses operate. You will work on machine learning models, natural language processing, and generative AI applications for enterprise clients. Responsibilities Design and implement machine learning models and pipelines Develop and deploy AI solutions for production environments Work with large datasets and optimize model performance Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities Stay updated with the latest AI/ML research and technologies Document models, experiments, and findings Requirements 3+ years of experience in ML/AI development Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) Experience with NLP, computer vision, or generative AI Knowledge of MLOps and model deployment practices Strong mathematical foundation in statistics and linear algebra Experience with cloud ML services (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI) Nice to Have Experience with LLMs and prompt engineering Publications in ML/AI conferences Experience with real-time ML systems
